Description: Unique identifier of the specific anaerobic lagoon configuration used.
The volumetric capacity of the anaerobic lagoon, in m$^3$. Note that this variable is a placeholder at this time,  and does not influence model calculations.
The type of cover used with the anaerobic lagoon.
The surface area of the anaerobic lagoon at the minimum operating level.
The number of days that manure is stored between emptying events. At the end of this interval, the manure storage is emptied completely.
